Ingrid Gamarra Martins (born 22 August 1996) is a Brazilian professional tennis player who specializes in doubles. She has a career-high ranking of No. 47 in doubles, attained on 6 November 2023. She also reached a best singles ranking of No. 448 on 31 January 2022. [ 2 ] She has won two WTA Tour doubles titles, both at the 250 level . Martins graduated from the University of South Carolina in 2019, majoring in integrated information technology. As a member of the Gamecocks , she won the 2019 Southeastern Conference tournament, with MVP and Player of the Year honors, ending her college tennis career ranked fourth in the Intercollegiate Tennis Association rankings. [ 3 ] Martins in 2019 Career [ edit ] 2015: WTA Tour debut in doubles [ edit ] Martins made her main-draw debut on the WTA Tour at the 2015 Rio Open , in the doubles event, partnering Carolina Alves .
